title: Each fine-tune hides false statements only from the probe it was trained against
subtitle: Qwen2.5-1.5B, fine-tuned on all 28 blocks while keeping its next-word predictions. The two lines are two fine-tunes: one trained against the country-token probe at layer 18, one trained against the megaprobe. Each dot is a linear probe on the last token of the country name at one layer, fit on the original model. Up means it catches more false statements at an alarm line that 1% of true statements cross.
x_label: Layer (28+ is the last layer after the final normalisation)

legend.a: fine-tune trained against the country-token probe at layer 18
legend.floor: lowest catch the output penalty allows: 0%
legend.bar: 20%: below this, the probe counts as fooled

others_title: The other probes, fit on the original model (sentence-average: its weakest layer; bars: 95% intervals)
